# Recording native libraries

The recording feature uses upstream libmpv builds with output muxers and video
encoders enabled. The Flutter plugin wrapper sources in the adjacent
`media_kit_libs_*_video` packages retain their upstream MIT licenses. The
native artifacts have separate upstream licenses and build terms; consult the
linked projects before redistributing the app.

## Android

The Android plugin downloads the `encoders-gpl` ABI bundles from
[libmpv-android-video-build v1.1.11](https://github.com/media-kit/libmpv-android-video-build/releases/tag/v1.1.11).
The build script pins and verifies the SHA-256 digest for each ABI archive.

## iOS and macOS

The Apple plugins download `video-encodersgpl` universal frameworks from
[libmpv-darwin-build v0.7.3](https://github.com/media-kit/libmpv-darwin-build/releases/tag/v0.7.3).
The upstream project documents the included components and their licenses in
its [README](https://github.com/media-kit/libmpv-darwin-build/blob/main/README.md).
The Makefiles pin and verify the SHA-256 digest of each archive.

## Windows

The Windows plugin downloads
[`mpv-dev-x86_64-20261019-git-6a262d11f6.7z`](https://github.com/shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake/releases/tag/20261019)
from the [mpv-winbuild-cmake project](https://github.com/shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake).
The app-local CMake recipe verifies its SHA-256 digest and bundles the libmpv
DLL with the ANGLE runtime DLLs required by the plugin.

## Linux

Linux continues to use the system-provided libmpv through the upstream media-kit
package. Recording requires that system library to include the needed output
muxers and encoders; this app does not pin or bundle a Linux libmpv build.
